user.title: Orchestra
user.description: Configure the Orchestra edge node and Conductor market broadcast receiver.

abort.already_configured: Orchestra is already configured on this Home Assistant instance.

apply_hvac_offset.name: Apply HVAC setpoint offset
apply_hvac_offset.description: Drift A/C setpoints by the Conductor offset from each unit's own starting setpoint, and restore it when the offset is 0. Safe to call repeatedly.

offset_sensor.name: Offset sensor
offset_sensor.description: The Orchestra setpoint offset sensor to follow.

invert_shed_when_heating.name: Shed downwards when heating
invert_shed_when_heating.description: Apply a load-shed offset as a drop while the unit is heating.

skip_when_off.name: Leave units alone while off
skip_when_off.description: Don't start a drift on a unit whose HVAC mode is off.

turn_on_for_pre.name: Switch on for pre-heat and pre-cool
turn_on_for_pre.description: Switch an off unit on for pre-heat or pre-cool, and back off when it ends.

apply_heat_pump.name: Apply heat pump signal
apply_heat_pump.description: Switch heat pumps on for Energy Soak and off for Load Shed, and put each back to what it was doing before on Normal. Safe to call repeatedly.

entity_id.name: Heat pumps
entity_id.description: Water heaters, climates or switches. With a power switch, these only get their temperature set and restored.

power_switch.name: Power switches
power_switch.description: Entities that switch the heat pumps on and off.

target_sensor.name: Target sensor
target_sensor.description: The Orchestra heat pump target sensor to follow.

boost_operation_mode.name: Energy Soak operation mode
boost_operation_mode.description: Water heater operation mode while soaking.

normal_operation_mode.name: Normal operation mode
normal_operation_mode.description: Mode to set when the event ends (otherwise the remembered one).

coast_operation_mode.name: Coast operation mode
coast_operation_mode.description: Mode to set when Load Shed starts.

boost_temperature.name: Boost setpoint
boost_temperature.description: Temperature for Energy Soak; 0 uses Conductor's target.

coast_temperature.name: Coast setpoint
coast_temperature.description: Temperature set when Load Shed starts; 0 leaves it.

normal_temperature.name: Normal setpoint
normal_temperature.description: Temperature set when the event ends; 0 restores the previous one.

rhythm_step.name: Run a rhythm step
rhythm_step.description: Called by the Orchestra rhythm blueprints at the start and end of each event on the Orchestra today calendar. Moves the devices and remembers them, so the end of the step puts back only what is still where Orchestra left it.

phase.name: Phase
phase.description: start moves the devices; end puts them back.

group.name: Group
group.description: Which step of the rhythm, such as west for the heat shield's west-facing blinds.

entity_id.name: Devices
entity_id.description: The blinds, curtains or switches for this step.

skip_today.name: Skip today
skip_today.description: Pauses every rhythm and Conductor until midnight, and puts back what the rhythms moved.

cooler_please.name: Cooler please
cooler_please.description: Ends Conductor easing the A/C for the current event, and eases it 0.5 °C less for a week.

force.name: Even on a normal day
force.description: Send it even when nothing out of the ordinary is planned.

headsup_time.name: Heads-up time
headsup_time.description: When the morning heads-up is sent (default 07:00).

open_up_earliest.name: Earliest open-up
open_up_earliest.description: Living area blinds open at sunrise but not before this (default 06:00).

hot_day_c.name: Hot day
hot_day_c.description: Forecast maximum at or above which the heat shield runs (default 28 °C).

notify_targets.name: Notify
notify_targets.description: Notify services for the heads-up, such as mobile_app_kitchen_tablet. Empty sends to every companion app.

weather_entity.name: Weather
weather_entity.description: Where the forecast comes from. Empty uses the first weather entity.

enabled.name: Rhythms on
enabled.description: Map of rhythm to true or false.
